translation: Took place in posad Serock, 20 September 1890, 8 AM. Appeared personally Josek Rubinsztejn, blacksmith, 38, and Berek Kołtun, cemetery attendant, 65, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 5 AM died in posad Serock Ruchla Makowska, one and a half years of age, daughter of Michel and Pessa, the Makowski spouses. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of Ruchla Makowska this act was read to the witnesses, signed by us and one witness; the second witness is illiterate.
